title: Decide the native sign-out Origin design: server exception vs iOS sending Origin
acceptance: The owner chooses between keeping withNativeSignOutOrigin (the server accepts a cookie-bearing JSON sign-out with no Origin, Referer or fetch metadata) and having iOS send a trusted Origin header, with the CSRF trade-off written down in authorization.md.
If the choice changes behaviour, a follow-up web or iOS task is created and the browser CSRF tests from RF-177 still pass.
nextAction: Owner decides before the standalone auth deploy (RF-183): #703's withNativeSignOutOrigin is on main and goes live with that deploy.

evidence.summary: Deferred design item (1) from the RF-177 reviews: the native sign-out origin handling itself is an owner decision.
Final review of #706: withNativeSignOutOrigin is on main (#703) but not in production, so the decision should precede the auth deploy; raised to P2 and made a prerequisite of RF-183.
